mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_history ( user_id, point_change, reason, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{pointChange}, #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT ph.id, ph.user_id AS userId, ph.point_change AS pointChange, ph.reason, ph.created_at AS createdAt FROM point_history ph INNER JOIN users u ON ph.user_id = u.id WHERE u.email = #{userEmail} ORDER BY ph.created_at DESC
